captions: Presentation captions added over the real local application. Business responses and downloads are real; all data is synthetic.

chapters.title: ScopeDesk / Scope before sales
chapters.body: Independent ITAD qualification prototype. Every enquiry, inventory row and correction remains traceable. Fictional data throughout.

chapters.title: 01 / Find the contradictions before replying
chapters.body: The enquiry asks for 120 laptops and 20 loose drives. Wrong site allocations, overlapping equipment outcomes and off-site data work block review.

chapters.title: 02 / Follow the evidence
chapters.body: Each finding links to original enquiry lines or CSV cells. Identifiers such as 0001 remain text. No drive count is inferred from laptops.

chapters.title: 03 / Record the customer clarification
chapters.body: The response becomes a new immutable source: 80 laptops Dubai, 40 Sharjah; reuse equipment and destroy the media on-site before collection.

chapters.title: 04 / Reconcile equipment and media independently
chapters.body: Source-linked corrections conserve the included quantities and clear the blockers. Laptop reuse and embedded-drive destruction coexist.

chapters.title: 05 / Freeze an immutable reviewed revision
chapters.body: The printable brief separates equipment, embedded media and loose drives. It retains requirements, source references and outstanding access-window actions.

chapters.title: 06 / Preview the LoopDesk handoff
chapters.body: The bounded JSON omits original documents and serial registers. The salesperson chooses existing CRM records and an owner before confirmation.

chapters.title: 07 / One case, one linked opportunity
chapters.body: LoopDesk creates an IT asset disposition opportunity at New, with an unknown estimate and a next action from the scope. Repeating the import creates no duplicate.

chapters.title: Reviewed history / ready for the next conversation
chapters.body: Later revisions attach to the same opportunity and preserve CRM fields. Local SQLite flow verified; PostgreSQL and HTTPS remain unverified.
